lane: color placement, outer/inner layer, diffuse brightness, surface finish versus moisture
reference_scope: Only visible facial impression; no identity, age, actual personality or body similarity claim. Hair is explicitly redesigned.

primary_visual_conditions.condition: Deep coffee-brown outer hair covers the crown and upper side, retaining dark local color between narrow reflections.
primary_visual_conditions.status_rule: PASS only when a contiguous outer dark panel can be identified at native pixels.
confusion_cases: a shadow over uniformly pale hair
colored light that supplies the darkness

primary_visual_conditions.condition: A broad pale neutral-silver inner panel grows below the lifted outer panel near the left ear/nape and continues to shoulder-length ends.
primary_visual_conditions.status_rule: PASS only when the brighter hair is a distinct broad inner layer, not isolated highlights.
confusion_cases: silver specular highlights on brown strands

primary_visual_conditions.condition: The lifted dark edge visibly overlaps the silver inner panel at the near ear/nape and leaves the silver panel readable underneath.
primary_visual_conditions.status_rule: PASS only when top-over-inner placement is visible in a single connected region.
confusion_cases: panel hidden by hand or collar

primary_visual_conditions.condition: The crown is dry and smoothly combed with fine separated strands and controlled satin gloss.
primary_visual_conditions.status_rule: PASS only when dry separated strands and a narrow reflection are both supported; sheen alone does not prove dry.
confusion_cases: matte dark hair with no readable finish

primary_visual_conditions.condition: Only the lower few centimeters of both colored layers form small irregular damp strand groups with distinct water beads on several ends, while the crown remains dry.
primary_visual_conditions.status_rule: PASS only when actual bead shapes and tip clumping can be read on hair; mere shine is insufficient.
confusion_cases: wet-look styling with no water evidence
raindrops only on the window or coat

camera_visibility.crop: entire crown through lower bench edge, vertical medium close-up
required_regions: tiny water beads on several hair ends
camera_visibility.lighting: neutral-white broad key with natural local color
camera_visibility.observability_rule: Hidden, cropped, blurred, or ambiguously lit conditions are UNOBSERVABLE_NOT_PASS, never PASS.

decision_rule: All five hair gates must PASS on saved native pixels. The neutral pre-core test remains an agent proposal and does not create a requester profile obligation. Retrieval, exposure, adoption, prompt audit and pixel results are separate evidence stages.
precore_access_statement: Only exact SKILL.md, neutral precore files, coordinator user-envelope, and supplied portrait were read. No source integration, assets, scripts, references, prior prompts, or other arms were read.
